_comment: Live, GitHub-Actions-verified remediation scenario: Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228) in a real Java/Maven app. No local JDK/Maven assumed on the demo host -- build, mvn test, and a real JNDI-lookup exploit probe run for real on GitHub Actions (see backend/app/remediation/actions_ci.py and remediation_targets/log4j-vulnerable-app/.github/workflows/ctem-verify.yml). The fix is a one-property pom.xml bump (log4j.version 2.14.1 -> 2.17.1), same deterministic-dependency-bump shape as the lodash scenario, just a different ecosystem and verification transport.

custom.name: Log4Shell — unauthenticated RCE via JNDI lookup in policy-admin-gateway
